plugins.name: nano-banana-prompt-generator
plugins.description: Write and improve prompts for Nano Banana - Google's Gemini image generation models. Covers Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3.1-flash-image), Nano Banana 2 Lite (gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image), Nano Banana Pro (gemini-3-pro-image) and the deprecated legacy gemini-2.5-flash-image, plus conversational editing, up to 14 reference images, video-to-image, in-image translation, search grounding, YouTube thumbnails and infographics.
